messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Beta release of Rattle 2.6.24
parts:
A new version of Rattle is being prepared for release. 

It is available with:

> install.packages("rattle", repos="http://rattle.togaware.com") 

The main changes have been bug fixes and code improvements, and conformance with the CRAN policies. The aim at present is stability and robustness rather than adding new features.

It is likely to go to CRAN early next week. Users are welcome to try this version out before then and let me know of any show stoppers. You can always revert to any of the older versions of rattle at any time. However, testing has indicated no issues at present (though MacOSX testing is yet to be done).

As always, feedback, suggestions, contributions are welcome.

Regards, 
Graham
